text:
Devon: Quick thread: propose PREPARE/ACTIVATE handshake for local control plane in customer VPC. PREPARE = allocate lease, fetch certs, run probes, dual-write mapping; ACTIVATE = flip dataplane. Main goals: source-ip preservation and safe cutover.
Lina: Agree. PREPARE should run TLS probe + tcp connect. Also record cert_seq and emit metric.
Hiro: How do we keep SNAT mapping sticky on failover? Idea: replicate mapping to global CP during PREPARE so fallback has warm state.
Lina: replication must be compact (per-tenant changelog) and idempotent. watch p99 replication lag.
Devon: Rollback plan: REVOKE that unpublishes mapping and falls back. Also short grace window where old path RSTs long connections to avoid silent stalls.
Hiro: KMS scope: local CP gets ephemeral wrapping keys only. Audit logs forwarded to global CP.
Devon: Rollout: label canary tenants (egress-canary=true), enable PREPARE/dual-write for 5%, measure replication lag + probe failures for 48h, then ACTIVATE.
infra-bot: Scheduled job queued: egress-replication-spike (job-9122).
Devon: TODOs: API snippet for PREPARE/ACTIVATE, implement changelog replication, add probe dashboards, run spike, write cutover playbook.
Lina: I'll own probe dashboard. Hiro will do the replication spike.
Devon: Thanks all — I'll draft the follow-up RFC section and link results.
